pattern: WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox with a tree popup (aria-haspopup=tree). The field keeps focus while typing; Down Arrow moves DOM focus into the popup tree, which follows the APG tree pattern (see Tree View); Escape returns focus to the field.

aria.value: true while the popup is open
required, error state, and help or error text
true, false, or mixed in multiple mode
true on the chosen node in single mode

keyboard.action: Filter the tree (opens the popup); the paths to matches stay visible.
Open and move focus into the tree (the selected node, or the first or last node).
Close the popup, or clear the search text.
Arrows, Home, End, type-ahead, * (see Tree View); Enter or Space chooses (single) or Space toggles the checkbox (multiple).
Close the popup and return focus to the field.

focus: Focus stays on the field until the user moves into the tree; choosing in single mode closes the popup and returns focus to the field. Leaving the control closes the popup and marks it touched (validation shows after blur).
notes: Added, removed, and cleared values are announced politely (WCAG 4.1.3).
Tags have remove buttons named "Remove <label>"; the clear button is named "Clear selection".
knownCaveats: Screen readers announce the popup as a tree only after focus moves into it.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
